procedural_matters: Sebastian MAYER (course race officer) attended the hearing representing the race committee.
NZL 3022 did not come to the hearing; the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.3(b).
facts: Uniform flag was displayed as a preparatory signal for the starting sequence of the Race 5 of the 29er Yellow fleet.
NZL 3022 was in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first markduring the last minute before the starting signal.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
